engagement.headline: Two paths. One goal: a better product.
engagement.intro: Whether you’re starting with an idea or improving software already in use, Aloden brings product thinking, AI, design, and engineering together to move from opportunity to production.

paths.title: Build something new.
paths.description: Turn an idea, business problem, or market opportunity into a production-ready digital product.

steps.title: Define the opportunity
steps.description: Clarify the problem, users, business goals, and product vision.

steps.title: Shape the product
steps.description: Define the experience, architecture, AI opportunities, and delivery roadmap.

steps.title: Design & engineer
steps.description: Build, integrate, test, and validate the product around real-world use.

paths.title: Make what already works significantly better.

steps.title: Improve & scale
